definitions.explanation: A state of being in a bad mood or visibly displeased. Used both as a noun and as a na-adjective to describe someone who is irritable, grumpy, or sulking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{不機嫌|ふきげん}だ。
examples.english: He's been in a bad mood since this morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不機嫌|ふきげん}な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}えなかった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My mother had a displeased expression, so I couldn't say anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不機嫌|ふきげん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The boss's grumpy attitude made the workplace atmosphere uncomfortable.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite of ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (being in a good mood) or ⟦{上機嫌|じょうきげん}→上機嫌：24293_joukigen⟧ (being in high spirits). Very common in daily conversation to describe someone's observable mood.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不機嫌|ふきげん}な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (a displeased face)
- {不機嫌|ふきげん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (a sulky attitude)
- {不機嫌|ふきげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become grumpy)
- {不機嫌|ふきげん}そうな (looking displeased)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{機嫌|きげん}が{悪|わる}い→機嫌が悪い：19531_kigengawarui⟧: in a bad mood — same meaning, more conversational
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧: dissatisfaction — focuses on the cause, not the visible mood
- ⟦{上機嫌|じょうきげん}→上機嫌：24293_joukigen⟧: in high spirits — the opposite
